deadline.value: Complete applications by November 30 for a competitive fellowship starting Fall 2027; the LRES regular deadline for international applicants is May 1.
deadline.quote: Applicants applying to the Ph.D. program are required to have a completed application submitted by November 30th if they want to be considered for a competitive fellowship that begins the following fall.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test applies to ecology and environmental sciences.

supervisor.value: A faculty mentor must agree to be the student's major adviser as a condition of admission.
supervisor.quote: An appropriate faculty mentor must agree to serve as the student's major advisor as a condition of admission.

funding.value: Stipends generally come from faculty grants; teaching assistantships are available on a limited basis, with no share of funded students stated.
funding.quote: Stipend and operations funding are generally from research grants and contracts awarded to faculty members, but graduate teaching assistantships and other forms of support are also available on a limited basis.

entry_route.value: Most students enter after a master's; exceptional students may apply directly after a bachelor's.
entry_route.quote: Students may undertake the Ph.D. following completion of a Master’s degree, or exceptional students may apply directly following completion of a suitable Bachelor's degree.

notes: Cross-college PhD run by the Ecology and Environmental Sciences program with participating departments (Ecology, LRES, Animal & Range Sciences, Plant Sciences, Earth Sciences, Microbiology). The Ph.D. is also listed as a biology program on the official list. The deadline comes from the LRES graduate page.
name: Ph.D. in Ecology and Environmental Sciences
